adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. Those expressions are evaluated immediately to a single literal string key (e.g., `"ZodString"` / similar), not a catch-all/dynamic key pattern. So the schema will require that specific property name rather than accepting arbitrary numeric expiry fields like `expires_in`/`expiry_date`. In the `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` path, `safeParse` will therefore fail on realistic token responses and `parseRefreshTokenResponse` will throw `Invalid refreshed tokens were returned`, breaking refresh flows (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom now call this function).
